subject: POC kickoff recap - Acme / Redwood
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff recap - Acme / Redwood

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our POC kickoff and next steps so we’re all aligned. I’ve attached the POC scope spreadsheet (POC_SCOPE.xlsx) and pasted the key items below.

Scope / goal
- Validate Redwood inference for Acme’s customer support summarization pipeline (batch + streaming).
- Success metrics: F1-summary quality target (internal eval) >= 0.78 vs. baseline, latency p95 < 200ms for single-doc summary, and cost target < $8 / 1M tokens after batching.

Evaluation / prompt set
- Acme to provide sample prompt set (30–50 prompts) + 200 representative transcripts for evals.
- Redwood will run automated evals using rouge/bertscore + human spot checks on a smaller set.
- Deliverable: evaluation report and recommended model / quantization profile.

Owners / roles
- Acme: Alicia Gomez (POC lead), Tom Reed (Infra / access).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Rishi Malhotra (SE), Dev Patel (Ops), Lauren Bishop (Eval lead).

Timeline
- Prep & access (this week): credentials, sample data, S3 path or Drive folder.
- Setup & baseline runs (week of Aug 30).
- Iteration & evals (weeks 1–3 of POC).
- Final report & next steps (week 4). Target length: 4 weeks total starting Aug 30.

Access / setup items (needed from Acme)
- Sample data: S3 bucket path or shared Drive link + example transcripts.
- Service account / read access to sample data OR one-off dataset upload.
- Security questionnaire point of contact for SOC 2 evidence: list of items in the attached sheet.

Immediate next steps
1) Alicia to share sample prompts + access to sample data by 2027-08-26.
2) Redwood (Rishi/Dev) to provision staging env and confirm test credentials.
3) Schedule weekly sync (30 min) during POC — propose Tue 10am PT starting Sep 1.

A few notes: we’ll aim to preserve prefix caching for repeated prompts to keep latency low; Rishi will propose batching settings after initial runs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: POC_SCOPE.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - Acme / Redwood

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures things well. Quick clarifications from Acme side: 

- We confirm the success metrics; we’ll share baseline scores for the 200 transcripts so you can compare.
- For data access: we’ll create a read-only IAM role and give you an S3 path (s3://acme-poc/samples/) by Thurs 8/26. Tom will follow up with the exact ARN.
- Security: our InfoSec team requires a short evidence packet (SOC 2 cert + data flow diagram). I’ve attached a recommended list in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cACME-poc-folder.

We’re aiming for a 4-week POC starting the week of Aug 30 — that works for our stakeholders. Also attaching one example transcript and a short set of initial prompts to get you started.

Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, AI Products | Acme Corp
[attachment: example_transcript.txt]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - Acme / Redwood

Looping in implementation details:

- Once we have sample data, we’ll run baseline inference on the same hardware profile we expect for the POC (g4dn.xlarge equivalent) and report p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens.
- For evals: Lauren, can you confirm the automatic metric suite (ROUGE-L, BERTScore) + two human raters for a 50-sample spot check? Suggested rubric: coherence, factuality, and helpfulness.
- Dev: please prepare a staging cluster and a short runbook for onboarding (role ARN, minimal network requirements).

Also, can Acme share an internal contact for rate limits or environments we should avoid hitting (e.g., dev vs. prod buckets)?

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - Acme / Redwood

Thanks Rishi — note answers below and attaching the initial prompt set (sample_prompts.csv).

- Human raters: confirmed — we’ll provide two SMEs for your human spot-checks.
- S3 access: Tom will create an IAM role with read-only access limited to s3://acme-poc/samples/ and share the role ARN by 8/26. Please only use the provided role; do not query other buckets.
- Rate limits: none specifically; just don’t do cross-account writes.
- Prompt set: attached sample_prompts.csv with 40 prompts; we’ll add 10 more by Friday if useful.

We’re on track to start baseline runs the week of Aug 30. One ask: can Redwood also provide a short troubleshooting checklist (common issues during onboarding) so our infra team can pre-validate?

Alicia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-24T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - Acme / Redwood

Perfect — thanks Alicia. Quick confirm:

- Acme to share S3 role ARN + sample_prompts.csv by 2027-08-26.
- Redwood to provision staging cluster and share test credentials by 2027-08-28.
- Kickoff run: week of Aug 30 (we’ll send calendar invite with a 30-min recurring sync).

Action owners summary:
- Acme: Alicia (POC lead) — provide data + raters + access.
- Acme: Tom (infra) — create/read role ARN.
- Redwood: Marissa (AM) — commercial owner and weekly sync; Rishi (SE) — technical lead; Dev (Ops) — staging & runbook; Lauren (Eval) — evaluation deliverables.

Deliverables by end of POC (week 4): baseline report, evaluation results, recommended model/config, and cost/latency breakdown.

I’ll send the calendar invite for Tue Sep 1, 10am PT as a recurring weekly 30-min touch. If anything changes on your side, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample_prompts.csv (csv)]
